headline: Ireland Reaches 3 GW Solar Milestone, Sets National Grid Record
meta_description: Ireland surpasses 3 GW of installed solar capacity and sets a new generation record of 1.3 GW on the national grid.
summary_short: Ireland has installed over 3 GW of solar capacity and achieved a new national record, with solar farms supplying more than one-third of the country's electricity at peak…
body:
Ireland has surpassed 3 gigawatts of installed solar capacity and set a new generation record of 1.3 gigawatts on the national grid. At certain hours, solar farms supplied more than one-third of the country's total electricity dispatch.

The milestone marks a significant step forward for Ireland's renewable energy transition. The record generation of 1.3 GW demonstrates that solar power can now reliably meet a substantial portion of the nation's energy needs during favorable conditions.

These achievements reflect growing momentum in Ireland's shift away from fossil fuels and toward cleaner energy sources, positioning the country as an increasingly serious player in Europe's renewable energy landscape.
quick_facts: Ireland installed over 3 GW total solar capacity
New national grid record: 1.3 GW single generation
Solar supplied more than 1/3 of electricity at peak hours
